name: interview-trainer
description: Interview Trainer Agent — RAG-powered job interview prep using IBM Granite on watsonx.ai
author: IBM Skills Build / AICTE-2026
problem_statement: Problem Statement No.22 — Interview Trainer Agent

required.WATSONX_API_KEY: IBM Cloud API key for watsonx.ai authentication

GUARDIAN_MODEL_ID.description: Optional Granite Guardian model ID for enhanced safety checks

features: Resume-aware interview question generation (RAG + IBM Granite)
Batch answer scoring with structured feedback (0–10 per question)
10-category guardrail system (injection, PII, content safety, bias, rate limiting, etc.)
Session-only privacy — no data persisted to disk
PDF and plain-text resume upload support
Roles: Full-Stack Developer, AI/ML Engineer, Cybersecurity Analyst

llm_call_budget.call_1: generate_questions — all N questions in one shot (temperature 0.5)
